scientific_conclusion: The sealed target-free 33-component descriptor does not predict the V65 signed pair residual in any held simulation domain. All three held-domain Pearson correlations are negative.
The pooled Ridge prediction is worse than the foldwise constant reference and has 47.9% sign accuracy. Its permutation statistics are not significant, so a nonlocal context head is not supported.

The failure of per-object bias, final-layer, and observable-context routing does not by itself rule out a pair objective because 2PCF is a population statistic. Requiring each noisy individual cube to share a gradient direction confounds the desired ensemble moment with cosmic variance.

The next no-refit audit must aggregate predicted and true pair moments across frozen train objects before taking their log ratio, then test that population gradient across disjoint source-balanced train folds.
